items.title: US stocks hit records (again...), but oil and earnings risks are growing. What can you trade?
items.summary: US stocks hit records, but oil and weaker earnings signals demand more selectivity US stocks remain supported by softer inflation and lower expectations for another Federal Reserve rate hike. However, two risks are becoming harder to ignore: elevated oil prices and a defensive shift in recent earnings reactions.
items.summaryZh: 美国股市创下纪录，但石油和疲软的盈利信号要求更多的选择性美国股市仍受到通胀放缓和美联储再次加息预期降低的支撑。然而，有两个风险越来越难以忽视：油价上涨和近期盈利反应的防御性转变。
